title: Background Schedulers & Snapshot Lifecycle (Orphan Overwrite, Concurrent Cycles, Single-Shot Boot)

findings.issue: Orphan overwrite: score_snapshots.py has no generation check before os.replace (line 116). After FuturesTimeoutError (lines 383-390), the abandoned thread still overwrites the file on disk.

Concurrent execution: resolver_scheduler.py uses shutdown(wait=False) (line 907) and releases _cycle_lock on abandon (line 759). The 1-2 min retry (line 651) launches a second cycle while the first is still running.
Single-shot boot failure: background_boot.py:30-55 catches Exception, logs a warning, and never retries. Any failure drops the service for container lifetime.
